messages:
lina: Noticing 413s from a canary hitting /v1/embeddings. Preflight OK but runtime rejects on shard-12. Anyone?
matt: Likely shard packing. Preflight uses global bytes->units mapping; runtime enforces per-shard byte caps.
nora: Sample: batch=10 dims=[512,1024,1024,512,256,1024,512,512,768,768], bytes~450KB. Preflight=10 units. Runtime -> shard split, 413 on shard-12.
oliver: Idea: add optional router RPC for preflight: `/rpc/estimate_pack` returns {decision, suggested_split, pack_score}. Opt-in via header `X-Embed-Prefer-Router: true`.
lina: UX: console should stop showing a single-point "Estimated units" without caveat. Change to "Preflight estimate (may vary by shard)" and show a link to detailed router estimate when available.
matt: Telemetry: add tags `router_checked` and `router_decision`. Metric `embed.preflight_runtime_mismatch` to alert on regressions.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-4621 created: "router-backed preflight estimator" assigned to oliver.
oliver: Plan: prototype RPC, flag behind `router_preflight_optin`, enable for canaries then tenants with high mismatch.
nora: Also add optional response field when split occurs and client requested advice: `split_advice: parts=2` so SDKs can auto-split. Opt-in header `X-Embed-Want-Split-Advice`.
lina: Sounds good. I'll update the quickstart docs and console copy. Follow-up in next sync.
